props.description: The doorway back to the undercroft, standing open.
A gold-bound chest, heavier than the reliquary and bright even in this dark. The latch yields.

props.revealHint: The gold chest sits a hand's width off the west wall; the stone behind it does not match. Searching the chest would find it.
props.description: A niche behind the chest, empty except for a ring of dust where something sat.
A stone stag, smaller than life, watching the door they came through.
A skull on the flags, the jaw still attached.
A ribcage slumped near the south wall.
A plaque on the east wall, the lettering too worn to read.
A pair of candles on the north wall, never lit.

dmNotes.overview: The last chamber. Dark. A gold chest on the west side, a stag on the east, and the open door they came through south. There is no door further on.
dmNotes.sensory: Still air, colder than the undercroft. Metal and dust. Their own breathing is loud.
dmNotes.theDoor: The door south stands open. A fight is the only thing that would stop them walking back.
